definition: An experimental method that compares two (or more) variants of a system by randomly assigning users or samples to each variant and measuring outcome differences.
details: A/B testing is widely used to evaluate real-world impact of model or product changes, including comparing different model versions or prompting strategies in production AI systems.
story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. That shared ruler is A/B Testing.
